definitions.link_key: name: diacritics folded, lower case, hyphens as spaces, tokens sorted
definitions.step_1b: first-name initial + surname + full birth date (first-name variants such as Dan/Daniel)
definitions.step_2: records without a birth date: name only, when exactly one person with that name has seasons within 4 seasons and no contradicting birth year
definitions.step_2b: records still unmatched: same league, same name, seasons within 4
nationality_order: citizenship (NHL first, else most frequent Liiga/SHL code)
eligibility or licence (DEL Nat, Extraliga foreigner flag, NL Swiss licence)
definitions.czechoslovakia: the NHL recodes Czechoslovak-era births to CZE or SVK; that code is used

sources.SHL: nationality where not N/A: citizenship (N/A before about 2010)
sources.Extraliga: foreigner flag: not a foreigner -> CZE (eligibility); foreigners have no code
sources.NL: Swiss licence -> CHE (eligibility); foreign licence and goalies have no code
sources.roster: World Championship and Olympic rosters from 2010: national team
